testcase.name: Scenario: Fit a small model from the wheel menu: tmp/obk-wheel-3945-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:103:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Fit a small model from the wheel menu ✔ Given a single rectangular block appears small in an active part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full navigation wheel is open ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Fit to Window ✔ Then the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport ✔ And the wheel remains open ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
